ts.api.doi_chieu_nam.cach_doc: Each year is placed on the rhythm of your numbers. If several events fall exactly on a year that opens or closes a cycle, or on a year that changes stage, that is a pattern for you to reflect on — if they do not line up, the numbers have said nothing about those events. Years follow the calendar year (from 1 January); the birthday-based year is noted alongside.

tsch.vt_mo_ta.ten_goi: The name others call you every day — the Chaldean school sees this as the clearest number.
tsch.vt_mo_ta.so_ten: Add the values of every letter in your full name.

tsch.vt_mo_ta.duong_doi: Add every digit of your day, month and year of birth.

tsch.luu_y: Numerology is a cultural lens for self-reflection, not a forecast. The two schools calculate differently, so they can give different numbers.
tsth.dd_chung: Life Path (both schools use the same sum of the birth date)
tsth.cach_doc: The two schools work from the same name and birth date using two different letter tables. Where they arrive at the same number is the trait worth checking first; where they differ, you get different angles to choose what is true for you.
tsth.ghi_chu_dd: The Life Path is the same sum of the birth-date digits in both schools, so it always matches — it is counted as one source, not as two schools agreeing.
tsth.luu_y: Numerology is a cultural lens for self-reflection, not a forecast.
tshd.nhip_cach_doc: Each person's Personal Year this year — when the two rhythms differ, one of you wants to push ahead while the other wants to slow down; knowing this in advance helps you not blame each other.
tshd.cach_doc: There is no compatibility score. Each pair of numbers shows where the two of you blend easily, where you tend to clash, and one concrete thing to do together — so you can look at how you treat each other.
tspn.luu_y: The two schools work from the same name and birth date using two different letter tables — pick the line that sounds truer to you.
tsnd.luu_y: Questions for reflecting on yourself through your own numbers — a reference point, not a prediction.
tshoi.khong_no_nghiep: By the method used here, your birth date and name carry no karmic debt (13, 14, 16, 19).
tshoi.sk.khong_bo_phan: Numerology does not link numbers to any part of the body, so it cannot tell whether something is wrong with your body — only a doctor's examination can.
tshoi.sk.he: If you are worried about your {he}, see {kham} so a doctor can check early.
